0022600133.text: The Washington Wizards (2-1, on a one-game winning streak and 3rd in the Southeast, 6th in the East) visit the Cleveland Cavaliers (1-1, on a one-game winning streak, 9th in the East and 1.5 games back in 3rd place in the Central). Washington is without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Justin Champagnie is day-to-day with a foot injury and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Wizards lost their last meeting 130-117 in Cleveland on April 12, 2026, part of a 2025-26 season series that Washington lost 0-4.
